text:
noah: Hey team, noticed a spike of ~400ms UI hitches when panning heavy dashboards on eu-canary after last night's client build. Looks like it correlates with the analytics sampling change. :grimacing:
riley: saw that in SLOs too. LCP is fine but first-interaction hangs a lot. Any hot paths?
mai: attaching a quick perf profile: https://perf.redwood/fg/1712006666 — main thread blocked in `inflateSync` inside our zlib-polyfill during `telemetry.decode`.
evans: wait, we intentionally moved the zlib helper into the main chunk in 2026-03-19 splitpoint change to reduce worker bootup. That would put inflate on main thread.
mai: yes. Also telemetry sampling was increased from 10% -> 35% for canary to get better coverage (changeset: analytics.sample_rate=0.35). More envelopes + sync inflate = more stalls.
noah: oof. So two factors: bundle placement and sampling. We should avoid sync inflate on main. Options: 1) revert the helper move, 2) lazy load polyfill into worker, 3) change sampling back.
evans: quick check of routing: our prefetch router also started `route_by_tenant` which increases duplicate prefetches across routes for multi-tenant dashboards. That inflates envelope count per session.
(quoted config)
```
# deploy 2026-03-19 22:12 UTC
analytics:
  sample_rate: 0.35  # was 0.10
routing:
  prefetch: route_by_tenant
bundle:
  splitpoints:
    common_helpers: removed
```
ops-bot: "canary deploy detected: analytics.sample_rate=0.35, routing.prefetch=route_by_tenant, splitpoint change id=sp-482"
riley: symptoms: - parse/inflate bursts (~80-150ms each, 3-5x per interaction) - main thread GC spikes - chart computeLayout queued while inflate runs.
mai: experiment: bumped a temporary flag `telemetry.use_worker_inflate=true` in eu-canary via ops console. ops-bot: "feature toggle set telemetry.use_worker_inflate=true for eu-canary at 1712006690"
noah: results: interactive hang median dropped to 60ms and CPU main went way down. Good quick win.
evans: we should revert the splitpoint that pulled helper into main and open a PR to move zlib into a worker-shared chunk. Also lower sample_rate back to 0.10 for canary until we get async path.
riley: I can flip sample rate now. ops-bot: "analytics.sample_rate set to 0.10 in eu-canary (change 2026-03-20 12:15UTC)"
mai: follow-ups: - create perf gate for parse+inflate time in release pipeline - add metric that counts telemetry-envelopes-per-session and track cross-tenant prefetch duplicates - update runbook: if main-thread inflate > 100ms for >30s pause analytics sampling
evans: adding ticket ENG-PLAT-798: bundle split + worker shared zlib. Also ENG-PLAT-799: routing prefetch dedupe by tenant-key.
noah: thumbs up. Leaving worker_inflate flag on for canary while tickets are in flight. Thanks team. :clap:
